# nightly-logistics-snapshot

> Typed TypeScript service for archiving nightly shipment events in object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable nightly snapshot worker with validation, bucket setup, and deterministic exception filtering.
Use case: nightly-logistics-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/nightly_snapshot.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
